title: Terms of Use — Vote-Scope
description: Vote-Scope's terms of use — how to cite projections, what the model can and cannot do, and the rules for reusing our content.
intro: VoteScope publishes electoral projections, visualizations and analysis for informational and journalistic purposes. These terms explain how the content may be used.
callout: Plain-language summary: You may read, share and cite VoteScope projections with attribution. They are not financial or strategic advice. They are probabilistic analysis — and they can be wrong.

sections.title: Projections are not guarantees
sections.bodyHtml:
Displayed seat projections and probabilities are the output of statistical simulations based on public polling. They reflect the model state at the date of the latest run — not a certain prediction of the final result.

Projections can and will change as new polls are published. VoteScope disclaims responsibility for decisions taken on the basis of these projections.

sections.title: Use and citation of content
sections.bodyHtml:
VoteScope projections, tables and visualizations may be:

  • Viewed freely without registration
  • Quoted in articles, broadcasts or analysis with clear attribution: “according to VoteScope (vote-scope.com)”
  • Shared on social platforms with a link to the source

Automated reuse or large-scale scraping of the data may eventually be governed by a separate API policy.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.bodyHtml: The model, code, visualizations and texts published by VoteScope are the property of Kim Leclerc. Raw election data comes from public sources such as Elections Canada, Elections Quebec, MIT Election Lab and polling firms.

sections.title: Third-party content and Polymarket
sections.bodyHtml: VoteScope may display prediction market data from Polymarket for comparison purposes. That data is provided “as is” — VoteScope is not responsible for its accuracy or availability. Polymarket is an independent platform with its own terms of use.

sections.title: Updates
sections.bodyHtml: These terms may be updated as the site evolves — including when premium features, a partner API or newsletter integrations are added.
